hero-lead.paragraph: We build websites, local search visibility, ad campaigns and practical automation for small and growing businesses.

overrides.title: Website Design & Development
overrides.description: Clear, fast websites that explain what you do and make it easy to call, book or buy.

overrides.title: SEO & Local Visibility
overrides.description: Show up when people nearby search for what you offer, in Google Search and on Maps.

overrides.title: Digital Advertising
overrides.description: Focused campaigns built around your services and budget, with reports you can read.

overrides.title: AI & Business Automation
overrides.description: Practical tools that take follow-ups, scheduling and other routine work off your plate.

overrides.heading: What we do.Four services, one team.
overrides.paragraph: Each one works on its own. Together they cover how customers find you, what they see, and what happens after they get in touch.

featured-meta.paragraph: TV mounting and AV installation · Chicago, IL

overrides.name: Elite Mechanical Services
overrides.descriptor: HVAC and refrigeration · West Chicago, IL

overrides.heading: Selected work.Five businesses, five live sites.
overrides.paragraph: Websites we designed and built for local businesses in the Chicago area. Each one is live. Open any of them.

overrides.heading: How we work.Practical, start to finish.
overrides.paragraph: No packages and no jargon. We look at the business first and build only what it needs.

overrides.label: First
overrides.statement: Start with the business, not a template.
overrides.paragraph: We learn how customers find you today and how work moves through your day before we design anything.

overrides.label: Then
overrides.paragraph: The simplest site, campaign or automation that does the job. Nothing you have to babysit.

overrides.label: After launch
overrides.paragraph: One point of contact for updates, fixes and the next improvement as your business changes.

contact-lead.paragraph: Tell us what you need. We'll figure out the next step together.
